summary: Region ensemble is coherently DVB-T: mean probability DVB-T 0.6493518253167471 vs WiFi 0.3368166039387385 vs LTE 0.013831571559421718 (top1-top2 margin 0.31253522137800854, normalized entropy 0.6427355644323047), and two of three members independently and stably top1 DVB-T with window agreement 1.0. Periodicity is not admissible corroboration here because the frozen gate is eligible=false (member top1 includes WiFi), so the large period_896us peak may neither support nor override the ensemble; the recommendation rests on the ensemble and member-level coherence alone and is therefore medium, not high.
model_evidence: Ensemble (mean_probability_across_members): DVB-T 0.6493518253167471, WiFi 0.3368166039387385, LTE 0.013831571559421718; top1 DVB-T with margin 0.31253522137800854 and normalized_entropy 0.6427355644323047.

iq_member_2: region top1 WiFi 0.5648483037948608 vs DVB-T 0.43340668082237244 (LTE 0.001745034009218216); window_agreement ratio 0.5, windows DVB-T 0.7912237644195557 then WiFi 0.922903835773468 — the sole dissenting member, and its DVB-T alternative remains a close second (0.43340668082237244).

Window-level direction: window 0 is DVB-T for all three members (0.9977352619171143, 0.7912237644195557, 0.9559255242347717); window 1 remains DVB-T for two members but with weaker confidence (0.5765321254730225 and 0.49910473823547363) while iq_member_2 flips to WiFi 0.922903835773468, so the region label is stable but in-region confidence is not.

risk_gate: unanimous_member_region_top1 = false, unique_top1_labels = [WiFi, DVB-T], reason = member_region_top1_disagreement — one member dissent is present and is carried into conflicting_evidence rather than down-weighted.
LTE is not a live hypothesis in this region: no member places LTE above 0.03829977288842201 and the ensemble gives it 0.013831571559421718.
periodicity_evidence: Energy-normalized complex autocorrelation over the complete continuous region (sample_rate 1000000.0 Hz, 4096 samples): period_66p67us lag 65 correlation 0.022954780608415604 (lte_score), period_224us lag 222 correlation 0.020038170740008354 (dvbt_2k_score), period_896us lag 896 correlation 0.21639098227024078 (dvbt_8k_score = dvbt_score), scores prediction_label DVB-T with margin 0.19343620538711548.
Frozen gate: reliability_margin 0.021475793793797496, eligible = false, reliable = true, resolved = false, changed = false.

eligible=false means the gate is out of scope for this case because a member region top1 includes WiFi (unique_top1_labels = [WiFi, DVB-T]); the 0.21639098227024078 peak at lag 896 (nominal period_896us) is therefore NOT admissible corroboration for DVB-T and is equally not usable to override the WiFi-containing member or to bypass class protection rules.

reliable=true additionally only attests that the correlation evidence is above the frozen reliability margin; it is not an independent class decision, so it does not convert the ensemble verdict into a gate-confirmed one.
Automatic resolution remained unresolved with review_reason = outside_periodicity_gate_scope, i.e. the gate neither resolved the conflict nor was applicable to it.
conflicting_evidence: iq_member_2 top1 is WiFi 0.5648483037948608 against DVB-T 0.43340668082237244, contradicting the two DVB-T members; its window predictions split 0.5 with a clean flip DVB-T 0.7912237644195557 → WiFi 0.922903835773468.
risk_gate unanimous=false with reason member_region_top1_disagreement, so the ensemble mean is masking a genuine member-level label disagreement.
Window 1 DVB-T support is weak (0.5765321254730225 and 0.49910473823547363, the latter essentially at chance), meaning the DVB-T region label is carried mainly by window 0.

The strongest single piece of periodicity-like evidence in the file (period_896us 0.21639098227024078) points DVB-T but is inadmissible under eligible=false, so it can be neither used as confirmation nor counted as agreement.
limitations: Single 1 MHz / 4.096 ms observation region — a local short-time snapshot with no frame-level or synchronization structure, so the recommendation cannot speak for other regions or times.
Correlation values and ensemble probabilities are model outputs, not calibrated probabilities or confidence estimates.
Window flips indicate in-region non-stationarity only; no synchronization or frame structure was detected or inferred.
iq_member_1/2/3 are same-type correlation models, so their agreement and disagreement are not calibrated independent evidence and one shared failure mode would move all three.
The periodicity gate is ineligible for this case, so no periodicity-based corroboration or correction is available; the DVB-T call rests on ensemble and member coherence alone.
This is a blind, non-operational experimental recommendation on an input already marked review_required with automatic_resolution unresolved, not a final decision.
